source: Surprise Withdrawal Shocks Mayoral Race
target: 意外退选震撼镇长选战

source:
Leading candidate for Asbury Pines Mayor Daniel B. Praetis has officially withdrawn from the race per his announcement on social media.  

Mr. Praetis, who teaches social studies at Asbury High, cited personal reasons for his impromptu departure from a race he was poised to win. “My family needs my full attention at this time, and running a campaign in addition to teaching at a high level is not currently possible with my limited time,” wrote Mr. Praetis. “We have a great set of mayoral candidates and I’m sure whoever wins will do a fantastic job. Thank you from the bottom of my heart for supporting me and my vision for our town. I'm sure you’ll see me again on the ballot!” 

Mr. Praetis could not be reached by our reporters for comment. With him withdrawn from the race, Alvin Van Eisen II, whose family roots in the town span decades, is the clear leader to take the Mayor’s Office.
target:
阿斯伯里松林镇镇长选举的领先候选人丹尼尔・B・普雷蒂斯，已透过社群媒体宣布正式退选。

在阿斯伯里高中教授社会科的普雷蒂斯先生，表示因个人因素，临时退出这场胜券在握的选战。他写道：「目前，家人需要我全心照顾。时间有限，我无法在维持优质教学的同时兼顾竞选。我们有一群优秀的镇长候选人，我相信无论谁当选，都会表现出色。衷心感谢各位支持我，以及我对本镇的愿景。我相信，大家还会在选票上看见我的名字！」

本报记者未能联络上普雷蒂斯先生取得回应。他退出后，家族在本镇扎根数十年的艾尔文・范艾森二世，已成为入主镇长办公室的明确领先者。

source: This Town Ain't Big Enough for Bank Robbers
target: 这个镇子容不下银行抢匪

source:
Sheriff Aldous Snow might as well be a gun-slinging lawman straight out of rough-and-tumble Dodge City. Several eyewitness testimonies confirm that he single-handedly foiled the attempted bank robbery at Sloan’s Loans and Savings.

Reports detail that the Sheriff pulled up just as the three shotgun-toting robbers were piling into their getaway pick-up truck. He fearlessly stepped out of his squad cruiser, shot out the truck’s rear tires and told the armed bandits, after blasting a side-view mirror with marksman accuracy, that they could leave the town in cuffs or body bags. All three chose cuffs.

Sheriff Snow, preferring to work without a deputy, declined to go into detail. Though he patted his holster and said he had to give some credit to Maggie, his .357 Magnum Smith & Wesson Model 19 revolver.
target:
阿尔道斯・史诺警长，简直像从狂野的道奇城走出来的快枪执法人员。多位目击者证实，他单枪匹马，挫败了斯隆贷款储蓄银行的抢案。

据报，警长赶到时，三名持散弹枪的抢匪正挤进接应的小货车。他毫不畏惧地走出巡逻车，射破货车后轮，再以精准枪法打碎一面后视镜，告诉这些武装匪徒：他们离镇时，不是戴手铐，就是装在尸袋里。三人都选了手铐。

一向喜欢独自办案、不带副手的史诺警长，拒绝详述经过。不过，他拍了拍枪套，说功劳也得分一些给「玛姬」——他的史密斯威森 Model 19 型 .357 马格南左轮手枪。

source: Legendary Shootout Brings National Fame to Local Lawman
target: 传奇枪战让本地警长名扬全国

source:
With a shootout arrest of smuggler kingpin Cal Holt, Sheriff Aldous Snow has cemented his legacy as a local legend. Collaborating with the Federal Bureau of Investigation and state troopers, Sheriff Snow spearheaded Operation Carousel, which involved judicial-approved wiretaps, undercover agents and tireless physical surveillance. All of it was delicately coordinated to prove that the Four Corners Service Station was a hotspot in an illegal trucking network for shipping contraband and drugs across the region.

Nearly a year of investigation culminated in a formal arrest warrant, which Sheriff Snow then used to charge after Cal Holt on the smuggler’s own turf. A shootout ensued at the service station that would rival any major-budget Hollywood production. Miraculously, Sheriff Snow emerged with a bullet to the calf as he took down three gang members and cuffed Cal Holt himself. 

Asked about what prompted his fearless bull rush, Sheriff Snow, economical with words, said, ‘I knew I was dealing with cowards when they kill a man’s police dogs and can’t face the man.’

National news media is currently spotlighting Sheriff Snow’s bravery and the Governor has shortlisted him for the Presidential Medal of Valor.
target:
阿尔道斯・史诺警长在枪战后逮捕走私头目卡尔・霍特，奠定了他作为本地传奇人物的地位。史诺警长与联邦调查局及州警合作，领导「旋转木马行动」，采取法院核准的监听、卧底部署与不间断的实地监视。各项工作经过周密协调，旨在证明四角加油站是非法货运网络的重要据点，负责在本区运送违禁品与毒品。

近一年的调查，终于取得正式逮捕令。史诺警长随即直捣卡尔・霍特的地盘。加油站爆发的枪战，场面足以媲美好莱坞大片。奇迹般地，史诺警长仅小腿中弹，便击倒三名帮派成员，亲手铐住卡尔・霍特。

被问及为何如此无畏地冲锋，惜字如金的史诺警长表示：「他们杀了一个人的警犬，却不敢面对那个人，我就知道自己对付的是一群懦夫。」

全国新闻媒体目前正聚焦史诺警长的英勇事迹，州长也已将他列入总统英勇奖章的提名名单。

source: Wildfire Blazes Across Swath of Crops
target: 野火吞噬大片农作物

source:
Asbury awakes this morning to the smell of smoke and ash. A wildfire on the edge of town razed a dozen acres of wheat crop in the sleeping hours of the morning. Fire departments from two neighboring towns were called in to subdue the flames and keep them from reaching residential areas. 

The fire was contained largely to the property of 387 West Chicory Lane, an old farm with 12 acres that was being rented and used by a small but growing counterculture group. No one is reported hurt, though, to the concern of the housemates, the property lessee Isaiah Kosztka is nowhere to be found. 

Fire Marshall Jack Duggard remarked that there is no conclusion yet as to the origin of the fire, whether it started in the fields or in the farmhouse. He added that his crew identified highly flammable chemicals in the basement of the farmhouse, which had combusted and essentially destroyed the foundations of the structure. “It was pretty much a tinderbox down there,” he said. “Investigations are ongoing, but we suspect the basement held a makeshift drug lab operation – harvesting the wheat fungus and making LSD or somesuch. Not uncommon these days.”

We will continue to follow this developing story and report on emerging details.
target:
今晨，阿斯伯里在烟与灰烬的气味中醒来。镇郊一场野火在凌晨人们熟睡时，烧毁了十二英亩麦田。邻近两个城镇的消防队受召支援，压制火势，防止延烧住宅区。

火势大致控制在西菊苣巷 387 号的范围内。那是一座占地十二英亩的老农场，由一个规模不大、却持续壮大的反主流文化团体承租使用。目前无人受伤，但让同住者担忧的是，承租人以赛亚・科斯特卡下落不明。

消防调查官杰克・达加德表示，起火原因尚无定论，也不清楚火是从田里还是农舍开始的。他补充，调查人员在农舍地下室发现高度易燃的化学品；这些物质燃烧后，几乎摧毁了建筑的地基。他说：「下面根本就是个火药桶。调查仍在进行，但我们怀疑地下室是临时制毒工坊，采集麦类真菌，制造 LSD 之类的东西。近来并不少见。」

本报将持续追踪事件，报导最新细节。

source: I-D Day Event Fallout: Updates, News, and Guidance
target: 断网日事件后续：近况、新闻与指引

source:
We the editors apologize for the brevity of our issues ever since I-D Day. National updates have been reaching us via dated radio systems and our generators can only power a fraction of our printing capacities. Remain sheltered, stock your goods, and observe curfews.  

Day three since Internet-Down Day – I-D Day for our everyday lexicons. Cybersecurity leaders have not ruled out terrorist motivations, though national intelligence agencies have confirmed that all nations on earth have been severely affected. The unthinkable has happened and our new reality is more dire than first expected: the internet no longer exists, and any device with internet capabilities has been rendered non-functional. 

Pentagon officials traced I-D Day to an event in Sri Lanka, where a malware with advanced artificial intelligence rapidly spread across the oceans of our internet and everything it touches. This malware, named Worm83, is motivated to expand until it destroys all it touches via commands that cause overvoltage in circuit boards both small and complex. 

Worm83's destruction includes everything from our smart devices like phones, microwaves, and coffee makers to massive server farms, factories, power plants, and entire communications networks. Much like for those on the other side of the world, our financial and economic systems remain at a standstill until a solution is found. 

Citizens are strongly advised to calmly follow the orders of national leaders and their local elected officials. Tomorrow at noon at Asbury Pines Town Hall, Mayor Alvin Van Eisen II will be announcing new community care and control protocols, including the rationing of food, fuel, and various goods.
target:
自断网日以来，本报篇幅缩减，编辑部谨此致歉。全国消息只能透过老式无线电系统传来，而发电机仅能支撑部分印刷产能。请留在安全处所，储备物资，遵守宵禁。

今天是网际网路瘫痪日——如今大家口中的「断网日」——后的第三天。资安主管尚未排除恐怖攻击的可能，然而国家情报机关已证实，全球所有国家都遭到严重影响。难以想像的事已经发生，我们面对的现实比最初预期更严峻：网际网路不复存在，任何具有连网能力的装置都已失效。

五角大厦官员将断网日的源头追溯至斯里兰卡的一起事件。一种具备先进人工智慧的恶意软体，迅速蔓延至整片网路汪洋，以及网路所接触的一切。这个名为 蠕虫83 的恶意软体不断扩散，透过指令使各种小型或复杂电路板过电压，摧毁接触到的所有装置。

蠕虫83 破坏的范围，从手机、微波炉、咖啡机等智慧装置，到大型伺服器群、工厂、发电厂，乃至整个通讯网络。与世界另一端的人们一样，在找到解方之前，我们的金融与经济系统仍将停摆。

强烈建议民众保持冷静，遵从国家领袖及地方民选官员的指示。明日中午，艾尔文・范艾森二世镇长将在阿斯伯里松林镇市政厅，宣布新的社区照护与管制措施，包括食物、燃料及各类物资的配给。

source:
My Lord of Reckoning and Rebirth, 

All thanks I give to Thee for guiding my apostles across the highways of death. We live in the burning of the world, the noble destruction. I am Thine instrument to restore Thy kingdom. In Thine name, we deliver into hellfire a band of mercenaries on the war-roads beyond town. Utmost Amen. 

From the deep North, my path of holy bloodening has followed Nadene,  Queen of Thine New Kingdom,  Angel of Life,  Eve of Thine Earthly Paradise -- my dear sister. Ten years gone. Ten years lost.  Ten years yearning. This divine mission, in Thine Good Name, brought me to the pagan hold of Asbury.

We rammed through the barricades and took the town like fires in Babylon. My apostles revved the armored trucks and hollered with hearts full of purpose. 

The people were many but they lacked guns – I knew this beautiful gift to be Thine sign. And so, we tore the pagans from their homes, chopped their beards and long hair and baptized them in the streets in Thine Holy Name. Our machetes blessed the resisters and released their souls. The head of their heathen chief Deborah Wolf is bathed in Thine Divine Light atop the post office flagpole. The satanic black flags of the defending mercenaries burn with your righteous fire. Glorious Amen.  

Fort Asbury is purged from earthly maps. This is now the heart of Thine Kingdom, Oh Lord. This is New Eden. Amen Amen.

我清算与重生之主：

感谢祢引领我的使徒，穿越死亡的公路。我们活在世界的烈焰中，活在崇高的毁灭里。我是祢重建王国的器皿。奉祢之名，我们在镇外的战火道路上，将一队佣兵送入地狱之火。至高的阿们。

从极北之地起，我沿着神圣染血之路，追寻娜汀——祢新王国的女王、生命的天使、祢尘世乐园的夏娃——我亲爱的姊妹。离去十年。失落十年。思念十年。奉祢良善之名，这神圣使命将我带到阿斯伯里这座异教据点。

我们撞破路障，如巴比伦的烈火般夺下城镇。我的使徒催动装甲卡车，满怀使命地呐喊。

居民众多，却缺乏枪械——我明白，这份美丽的礼物就是祢的征兆。于是，我们把异教徒从家中拖出，削去他们的胡须与长发，在街头奉祢圣名为他们施洗。我们的砍刀祝福反抗者，释放他们的灵魂。他们的异教首领黛博拉・沃尔夫，头颅高挂邮局旗杆，沐浴在祢的神光里。防守佣兵那些撒旦的黑旗，在祢公义的火中燃烧。荣耀的阿们。

阿斯伯里堡已从尘世地图上抹去。主啊，这里如今是祢王国的心脏。这里是新伊甸。阿们，阿们。

source: Local Bull Sees Opportunity in Our Backyards
target: 本地投资大户看中我们后院的商机

source:
Finn Sloan built the fortune of Sloan's Loans and Savings by holding his cards close to his chest, never so much as blinking for concern of telegraphing his next investment move. However, in a rare interview, he has offered insights into his current, and seemingly biggest, business endeavor: real estate. 

In the past few months alone, Mr. Sloan has purchased a 38-acre plot of farmland on the borders of town and has become majority-owner of both Windber’s Bakery and Daleview Poultry Farms, Inc. His appetite for property has only grown. 

“As a money lender, my goal is to serve as a strong foundation of support to our community,” Mr. Sloan said. “This town is blessed by God, and I want to prop up and grow every righteous business I’ve come to know and love.” Critics have pointed out that his aggressive purchases combined with his control over lending rates will turn a town of property owners into renters. 

Interestingly, a flurry of updates to real estate title records has shown that Miss Claudette Vivienne, owner of local jazz hotspot Vivienne’s Cafe, has also been gobbling up residential property and selling at deep discounts to those close to her. An investment fad, or are investors firming up assets ahead of tough times? Those of us on the sidelines will soon find out.

芬恩・斯隆一向深藏不露，连眼都不肯多眨，唯恐泄漏下一步投资动向，借此打造斯隆贷款储蓄银行的财富。然而，在一次罕见的专访中，他透露了目前这项看来也是规模最大的事业：房地产。

光是过去几个月，斯隆先生便买下镇界一块三十八英亩的农地，并成为温德伯面包坊与谷景家禽农场公司的多数股权持有人。他对地产的胃口，仍在增长。

斯隆先生表示：「身为放款人，我的目标是成为支撑社区的坚实根基。这个镇子受到上帝祝福，我想扶持并壮大每一家我熟悉、喜爱的正派商家。」批评者指出，他积极收购，加上掌控放款利率，会让一座由屋主组成的城镇，变成租客之城。

有趣的是，近期密集更新的不动产产权纪录显示，本地爵士乐热点薇薇安咖啡馆的老板克劳黛特・薇薇安小姐，也在大量购入住宅，并以大幅折扣转售给亲近的人。这是投资风潮，还是投资者正为艰困时期巩固资产？旁观的我们，很快就会知道。
